description: This file implements filtering functions 'filter_exclude' and 'filter_include' for processing lists of strings based on file pattern matching, used within the 'functions' namespace.

methods.name: RunFilter
methods.description: Core function that filters a list of string values based on include or exclude patterns, invoked by specific filter functions.

methods.name: RunFilterExclude
methods.description: Filters out values matching exclude patterns.

methods.name: RunFilterInclude
methods.description: Filters in values matching include patterns.
